body.description: Wavelet: a small microwave oven creature, boxy beige body, the glass door is a face with a dim turntable glow inside, keypad on its side like freckles, short stubby legs, humming, waiting patiently. a small living machine creature (an Ohm), an old household or farm machine that woke up with a will of its own, weathered by years outdoors, no humans, no rider
body.style_description: modern indie action-adventure pixel art: chunky stylized proportions, big bold readable silhouette, saturated colours, lineless with strong graphic light and shadow shapes, expressive and punchy
